title: It's a shame what's happened to radio
summary: A personal blog post expressing nostalgia and disappointment about the decline of radio as a cultural medium, reflecting on how the golden age of radio has passed and been replaced by streaming services and podcasts.
problem_solved: Not a technical solution - expresses personal sentiment about changes in broadcast media
why_valuable: Offers a nostalgic perspective on media evolution and sparks discussion about cultural shifts in audio entertainment
